metadata.description: Parallel threads: churn analysis (A) vs feature adoption patterns (B)

turns.content: I want to investigate two things today. First, churn patterns by account tier. Second, feature adoption by cohort. Let's start with churn analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge both threads and start with churn

turns.content: For churn, only count accounts with subscription status 'cancelled'.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use cancelled status for churn definition

turns.content: Now let's switch to thread B — what's the 30-day feature activation rate for accounts who signed up in 2024?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate feature activation within 30 days for 2024 signups

turns.content: For activation, only count features used at least 5 times in the first 30 days.

annotations.establishesFilter: Activated = feature used >= 5 times in 30 days

turns.content: Is there any overlap? Do the high-churn Enterprise accounts have lower feature adoption?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should cross-reference both threads to find correlation

turns.content: Thread A — what features did churned accounts use before leaving?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show feature usage for churned accounts

turns.content: Thread B — do accounts that activate within 7 days have better retention?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze retention for quick activators

turns.content: Earlier in thread A we looked at Enterprise churn. What was the average contract value?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Enterprise contract value from thread A

turns.content: Apply the same churn definition to show me churn rate by industry.
Apply the same activation threshold to show me activation by account age.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 5+ uses in 30 days

turns.content: Exclude trial accounts from both threads.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial tier for both threads

turns.content: Both threads compared — is there a pattern where low-activation industries have high churn?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should synthesize findings from both threads

turns.content: What filters are active for thread A?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list thread A filters: cancelled status, exclude trial

turns.content: Synthesis — which insights are actionable across both threads?
